description: Change one of an athlete's goal races in place: its priority (A, B or C), date, name, goal time, distance or location. Find it by race_id from target_races, or by its name. The other races are left as they are, so this is the way to re-rank a season — call it once per race whose priority changes. Says back every race as stored.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

distanceType.description: Sprint to 140.6 are triathlons; Hyrox is 8 × 1 km runs, each followed by a station; Custom is anything else.

name.description: Race name, e.g. "Ironman 70.3 Zell am See"

race_name.description: Or its name, or a part of it that matches one race only (e.g. "Thun").

name: update_goal_race
